title: No reproducible accuracy gain from lightweight attention modules in fine-grained classification of 39 toxic Chinese herbal medicines: code and analysis artefacts
description: Code, twelve-run factorial metrics, bootstrap intervals, figures and analysis notebooks accompanying the manuscript on a 39-class plant-derived toxic CHM image classification benchmark. The image dataset itself is the public Figshare deposit DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.31136233 and is not redistributed here.
